newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KLI says doesn't know why stock surged.
newsitem.headline: KLI says doesn't know why stock surged.

text.p: Property and consumer products firm Kuala Lumpur Industries Holdings Bhd (KLI) said on Tuesday it was not aware of reasons for the stock's surge.

"We are not aware of any rumours or affairs not previously disclosed or any other reasons and existing conditions to account for the unusual market action" except that related to a subsidiary, KLI said.

In a reply to a Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange query, the company said subsidiary Malaysia Electric Corp Bhd (MEC) has recently had 3,000 acres of land set aside for a proposed electrical appliances project.
On Tuesday, KLI stock rose to a 12-month high for the second day running. It hit 4.66 ringgit before ending at 4.48, up four cents in the market's heaviest volume of 30.7 million shares traded.
